# AppsHub Project Development Checklist

## Project Overview
Building AppsHub - a professional full-stack app marketplace platform with React.js frontend and Express.js backend, featuring user authentication, app listings, categories, bidding system, and comprehensive analytics.

## Setup Checklist

- [ ] Backend Setup & Dependencies
  - Install backend dependencies
  - Configure TypeScript compilation
  - Set up MongoDB connection
  - Create environment configuration

- [ ] Backend Data Models
  - User models (Company, Freelancer)
  - App listing models
  - Category models
  - Review & rating models
  - Bidding/project request models

- [ ] Backend API Implementation
  - Authentication routes & JWT setup
  - User profile management routes
  - App management routes
  - Category routes
  - Bidding system routes
  - Review routes
  - Search & filtering logic

- [ ] Frontend Setup & Configuration
  - Create React TypeScript project
  - Install dependencies (Tailwind, Axios, Redux)
  - Configure Tailwind CSS
  - Set up folder structure

- [ ] Frontend Components - Core
  - Navigation/Header component
  - Footer component
  - Theme toggle (Dark/Light mode)
  - Loading & error components
  - Modal/Dialog components

- [ ] Frontend Pages - Authentication
  - Login page
  - Registration page
  - Email verification page
  - Role selection page
  - Password reset page

- [ ] Frontend Pages - User Profiles
  - Company profile creation form
  - Freelancer profile creation form
  - Profile management page
  - User dashboard

- [ ] Frontend Pages - Marketplace
  - Landing page with hero section
  - Search bar implementation
  - Category filtering grid
  - Featured apps showcase
  - App details page

- [ ] Frontend Pages - Developer Tools
  - App submission form
  - Service listings page
  - Demo scheduling component
  - Blog/updates section
  - Documentation viewer

- [ ] Frontend Pages - Bidding & Community
  - Project request creation form
  - Bidding interface
  - Bid management dashboard
  - Reviews & ratings display

- [ ] State Management & Services
  - Set up Redux store or Context API
  - API service layer (Axios)
  - Authentication context
  - App state slices

- [ ] Integration & Testing
  - Connect frontend to backend APIs
  - Test authentication flow
  - Test app listing flow
  - Test search & filtering

- [ ] Deployment Preparation
  - Build scripts configuration
  - Environment setup
  - Error logging setup

- [ ] Documentation Complete
  - Update README.md
  - API documentation
  - Component documentation
